title: I-007 RetimeMap / NestResolver (DEV-PURE)
clauseOfficialized: Linear and piecewise-linear TimeMap sourceAt and inverse mapping use exact Q. knots (0,0),(2,1),(4,5) map local 3s to source offset 3s; a split at 3s inserts the same mapping point on both segments. 300 frames at 30000/1001 with 48 kHz has no cumulative drift through the map (480480 samples). Caption source anchors use invert(v), not FrameRate.frameIndex. Optical-flow / frame-blend interpolation is RETIME_INTERP_UNSUPPORTED and does not steal duration. Reverse is RETIME_DIRECTION_UNSUPPORTED, not faked as a positive rate. Non-monotone or bad endpoints are refused. Nest cycles are NEST_CYCLE; depth greater than 8 is NEST_DEPTH. sourceAt composes a nest stack of TimeMaps.
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: I-007 was still planned. Existing code only used linear rate TimeMaps on the I-006 persist path and had no RetimeMap, inverse mapping, split, nest DAG validator, or official I-007 sourceAt tests.
rowsStillOpen: MakeCompound persist / external-link inclusion or unlink first
